#labels Phase-QA,Phase-Deploy
= How To Test PariDroid in Emulator =

  * Create the android virtual device:
{{{
android create avd --name android8 --target android-8
}}}
  * now start the emulator
{{{
emulator @android8
}}}
  * push the apk to the emulator (Assuming you are in `PariDroid/bin`)
{{{
adb -e install PariDroid-debug.apk
}}}
   * *NOTE:* If PariDroid is already instaled, use the `-r` flag, i.e.
{{{
adb -e install -r PariDroid-debug.apk
}}}
  * Then launch the application in the emulator.
  * To read debug messages, use `adb logcat` in the shell.
